title: Not the gift for our Maine Coon
text: It's a very cute box of toys and treats.  Unfortunately when my Maine Coon got her Christmas box she wasn't interested in any of it. I tried adding catnip to the toys, but still no go!  Instead she played with the garland on our tree and removed ornaments each night. Perhaps it's a Maine Coon thing? Anyone have a similar experience?  I'll update this if things change when the tree is gone.  I was so disappointed in her lack of reaction
label: neutral
